name: claude-code-vertex
description: Claude Code CLI in --bare mode, routed to Claude on Google Vertex AI rather than the Anthropic API. Identical to the claude-code profile apart from pinning a model that Vertex deployments actually serve.
verificationNote: Verified against a live install (claude 2.1.220) routed to Vertex AI. Requires four environment variables that this profile deliberately does not encode, because they are deployment configuration rather than invocation arguments: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1, ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID, CLOUD_ML_REGION, and GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS pointing at a service-account JSON file. Model availability is per-deployment and must be checked before a run: on the deployment used here, claude-sonnet-5, claude-sonnet-4-6 and claude-opus-4-6 all answered, while Claude Code's own default (claude-sonnet-4-5@20250929) returned 'not available on your vertex deployment' -- which is why the model is pinned explicitly rather than left to the CLI default. Opus 5 is not offered on Vertex at all. Cost IS reported: a smoke test returned total_cost_usd of 0.0131 (few-tools prompt) and 0.0545 (many-tools prompt), so per-invocation cost is captured for this profile. Those are the CLI's own figures computed from token usage; Vertex is partner-billed at rates that differ from first-party, so treat them as a close estimate and reconcile against the cloud project's billing for anything that matters financially.
